edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 25,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after both parties sign this Agreement, by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the matters resolved by this Agreement, whether known or unknown, through the date both parties sign this Agreement. This release does not affect either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal and tax advisers; disclosures reasonably necessary for tax reporting or compliance with law, regulation, or a regulatory request; and disclosures required by court order. A party making a required disclosure shall, where legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party advance notice.
